newsitem.title: USA: Santa Clara, Calif., voters approve $350 mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Santa Clara, Calif., voters approve $350 mln bonds.

text.p: Voters in Santa Clara County, Calif., on Tuesday approved three school bond measures, raising $350 million for local districts, election officials said.
Voters in the county approved the following measures:
* $165 million of general obligation bonds for the San Jose Unified School District to pay for school repairs and wiring.
* $145 million of general obligation bonds for the Santa Clara Unified School District to replace and renovate district schools.
* $40 million of general obligation bonds for the Saratoga Union School District to repair schools and add classrooms to alleviate overcrowding.
